title: Spirited Away Stage Play's World Tour Unveils Cast
content:
The official website for the stage play of Hayao Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli 's Spirited Away anime film announced the cast members for the stage play on Thursday.

Kanna Hashimoto (live-action Gintama , Kaguya-sama: Love is War , Kingdom , top row, leftmost in image above), Mone Kamishiraishi ( your name. , live-action Chihayafuru , LDK , top row center left), and Momoko Fukuchi (live-action Wasteful Days of High School Girl , Radio Star , top row, center right) all return as Chihiro. Hashimoto and Kamishiraishi alternated in the role in the stage play's first run in 2022, and Fukuchi was one of two actresses that also played the character alongside Hashimoto and Kamishiraishi in the stage play's 2024 run. Marina Mori ( High School Musical stage musical in Japan, top row, rightmost) will be the understudy for the Chihiro role, as she had been during the play's 2024-25 London run, 2025 Shanghai run, and 2026 Seoul run.

Nagi Inoue ( Nogizaka46 member), Hana Toyoshima, and Kokoro Hirasawa (bottom row, left to right) join the cast, though their roles remain unannounced.

The stage play will have a world tour with stops in Toronto, Los Angeles, London, Taipei, and Tokyo. The tour dates are as follows:

• Princess of Wales Theatre - Toronto, Canada: May 6-August 15, 2027

• Ahmanson Theatre - Los Angeles, California: September 2-October 24, 2027

• London Coliseum - London, England: March 2028 onwards

• National Theater - Taipei, Taiwan: December 16, 2026-January 31, 2027

• Tokyo, Japan: March-May 2027

Tony and Olivier Award-winning director and the Royal Shakespeare Company's Honorary Associate Director John Caird (Les Misérables, Nicholas Nickleby, Daddy Long Legs) directs and co-adapts the production with Maoko Imai.

The stage play ran at the London Coliseum theatre from April to August 2024. The London run won the Best New Play award at the 25th Annual WhatsOnStage Awards in London in 2025.

The stage play ran in Japan with two different sets of cast members. The play's first run debuted at the Imperial Theatre from February to March 2022, then went on tour to Osaka in April, Fukuoka in May, Sapporo in June, and Nagoya in June and July for a total of 102 performances.

The stage play returned for its second run in Japan in August 2023 and March 2024.

GKIDS theatrically screened a recorded performance of both versions of the stage play. The version with Hashimoto screened in North America in April 2023, and the version with Kamishiraishi screened in late April and early May in 2023.

Spirited Away was previously the highest-grossing Japanese film worldwide until Demon Slayer – Kimetsu no Yaiba – The Movie: Mugen Train surpassed the record. Spirited Away remained the only non-English-language title to win the Academy Awards' Best Animated Feature award, which it earned in 2003, until Hayao Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli 's latest film The Boy and the Heron won the award in 2024.
author: ANN

title: Naruto’s New Manga Return Will Make Boruto Obsolete
content:
The Naruto franchise is planning to expand in a way that hints at trouble for the official sequel, Boruto , and its current manga installment, Two Blue Vortex . The original Naruto manga wrapped up its narrative with a perfect ninja story, leaving no loose ends that necessitated a sequel. However, a sequel was still announced, and while some fans were happy to see the story continue, many rolled their eyes at the idea of a series centered on none other than Naruto’s son, Boruto. It never made much sense, and the series initially felt like a forced installment.

What actually intrigued fans was how the Boruto manga introduced a narrative suggesting that something had gone wrong with the franchise’s original protagonist, Naruto, prompting fans of the original series to see what the sequel had in store for their beloved character. The series continued to develop over the following years, gradually establishing its own identity while using nostalgic elements from the original manga to keep fans intrigued and satisfied. The first installment eventually concluded, with Two Blue Vortex now serving as the best source for exploring the Naruto franchise. However, the interquel announced by the franchise’s original creator could overshadow Boruto , potentially preventing it from receiving the attention it deserves.

Naruto ’s New Manga Might Overshadow Boruto

When Boruto was first announced, it was also revealed that the original creator would not be writing the series, with a new writer and illustrator taking over instead. This made it even harder for some fans to follow the series. However, it took years for Boruto to develop its own identity, and now that it has, the original creator is reportedly returning with a new series depicting the original heroes’ lives after the events of Naruto Shippuden . This is what fans had imagined when they first heard about a sequel instead of Boruto .

The teasers and details so far hint that the series will explore Naruto and Sasuke’s adventures before Naruto became Hokage . This is something fans have long wondered about, as Naruto was still a Genin at the time. With the series potentially revealing how he acquires the appropriate rank, fans may finally get to see that journey unfold. This could include Team Seven embarking on adventures together again, while Sasuke reflects on his actions and takes on the role of a shadow ninja protecting Konoha in his own way, which may explain why the series is tentatively titled Naruto: Shadow Rising .

The hints have also depicted Sakura with a child, suggesting that the series could explore her romance and marriage with Sasuke, alongside Naruto and Hinata’s relationship and the birth of their children, symbolizing the arrival of the next generation. Ultimately, with the original creator at the helm, Naruto ‘s new manga is poised to deliver a heavy dose of nostalgia that could overshadow Boruto ‘s monthly chapter releases. This is especially true if the new manga follows a weekly release schedule, given that it is one of the major projects announced as part of a multi-year initiative expected to last two to three years. That said, Boruto is still developing and has reached a crucial stage in its story . Naruto ‘s new manga could instead encourage more fans to read the sequel, as it may provide the proper setup for its events.

Naruto ’s New Series Could Give Boruto the Boost It Needs for Its Final Moments

Given that the Boruto series has evolved into something of its own, with the original characters no longer at the center, Kishimoto’s intention likely isn’t to overshadow the proper sequel with a new interquel. This is evident from how Kishimoto himself took over as the writer of the sequel after Boruto: Naruto Next Generations reached chapter 50. With that in mind, Kishimoto might be laying more groundwork for Boruto ‘s sequel, especially as the series appears to be approaching a crucial point and potentially heading toward its final arc. The interquel could eventually lay the groundwork for the idea that something far greater than the original series’ final villain, Kaguya, has always existed.

Naruto and the others could encounter this new development, hinting at a future threat they won’t be able to face themselves and will have to leave to the next generation, Boruto and the others. Adding to this speculation is Kashin Koji’s prescience, or ability to see the future, which could play an important role in informing the original characters of the potential danger and why the next generation stands a chance when they do not. In any case, it is exciting news that none other than the original series’ creator is returning with an interquel that few expected to see . While there is a possibility that this new Naruto manga could overshadow Boruto , it could also give the sequel the necessary boost, serving as a proper bridge to the Boruto series.

title: The Vermilion Mask Releases Creditless Opening and Ending Videos Following Premiere
content:
The Vermilion Mask released its creditless opening and ending videos following the anime’s October 10 premiere. The opening features MAN WITH A MISSION’s “Firestarter,” while yutori performs the ending theme “Koe.”

MAN WITH A MISSION commented on “Firestarter”:

“a powerful song, one that could give a push to the adventure of these young people who have been saddled with such a cruel fate.”

yutori also commented on “Koe,” which means “voice”:

“You can’t erase the past, but the act of carrying it and still trying to move forward is surely something that overlaps with our own everyday lives.”

The anime was previously confirmed as a two-part series, with the first cour set to run in Fall 2026. The anime is directed by Tetsuaki Watanabe with One Double-O studio handling animation production. Daisuke Ohigashi oversees the series composition, Hisashi Higashijima serves as character designer and chief animation director, and Alisa Okehazama is composing the music. Original creators Dr. Poro and Nabana Naba are also supervising the story. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.

Leading the main voice cast is Taihi Kimura as Peru d’Arrest, following his recent announcement as the voice of Chihiro Rokuhira in the upcoming KAGURABACHI anime. Joining the main cast are:

• Kenji Nojima as Hien

• Aoi Koga as Lasgarl

• Yuki Shin as Clown

• Akihisa Wakayama as Rinne

• Aya Endo as The Mask of Necromancy

• Yui Horie as Master

The series adapts the manga written by Dr. Poro and illustrated by Nabana Naba, currently serialized in Young King OURs magazine from Shonengahosha.

title: Croquette!'s Manavu Kishimoto Launches New Manga
content:
Manga author Manavu Kashimoto launched a new manga titled Tantei Neko Machida (Detective Neko Machida) on Shogakukan 's Weekly Coro Coro Comic online magazine on Tuesday.

The unorthodox mystery manga centers on the mysterious detective Neko Machida and his assistant Myako, who solve difficult cases using their unique deductive abilities.

Kashimoto debuted the original Croquette! manga in Shogakukan 's Monthly Coro Coro Comics magazine in 2001. The manga inspired a television anime adaptation in 2003.

Kashimoto launched the Croquette! Black Label sequel manga in Shogakukan 's CoroCoro Aniki magazine in December 2017. The manga moved to the Weekly Coro Coro Comic online magazine in 2022, and ended in May 2025.

Kashimoto's Shuriken Tonma manga was featured in the 40-Shūnen da yo! Coro Coro All-Star Shōgakkō OVA in 2017. Shogakukan shipped the first compiled book volume in September 2016, and the series concluded in the fifth volume in March 2018.

Kashimoto's Henoheno Kappa Sensei manga ended in its eighth volume in 2024.

title: Bass X Machina Teases Star-Studded Cast With New Netflix Trailer – Watch
content:
Bass X Machina is bringing a star-studded cast to Netflix with a cool looking new animated series coming later this Fall, and Netflix has dropped a new look at what to expect with a new trailer. Netflix has a lot of action anime and animated projects that fans should check out right now, and some of the standouts have been with animation produced by Studio Mir. After finding success with two seasons of Devil May Cry (with a third on the way ), the studio is coming back with a strong looking new hit.

Bass X Machina is an updated take on the legendary historical figure Bass Reeves, and it’s being revived with an action heavy steampunk world that fans will want to jump into. Starring Academy Award nominated Brian Tyree Henry in the titular role (along with a number of big names joining the cast for the occasion), Netflix has dropped the first full trailer for the upcoming limited series ahead of its debut this November. You can check it out in action below.

When Does Bass X Machina Come Out on Netflix?

Bass X Machina will be making its worldwide debut with Netflix on November 3rd, and will be a limited series running for only six episodes in total. The series was created by LeSean Thomas (who has already made waves with Netflix on anime projects such as Yasuke and Cannon Busters ), and he’ll also be serving as executive producer alongside Brian Tyree Henry, Jennifer Wiley-Moxley, and Chad Handley. It’s going to feature animation from production studio Studio Mir, that’s been behind hits like Devil May Cry, The Legend of Korra, X-Men ’97 and much more.

Bryan Tyree Henry stars in Bass X Machina as the voice of Bass, and he’s joined by a star-studded cast including the likes of Janelle Monáe as Glory, Tati Gabrielle as Dana, Cree Summer as Ahni, Chaske Spencer as Lighthorse, Currie Graham as Rivenbark, Starletta DuPois as Etta. Monáe even will be providing the official theme song for the limited series titled “HONOR KiLLING.” And as the trailer for the series teases, it’s going to be tackling the legendary historical figure in whole new way. Which will be familiar to fans of the Yasuke anime series as well as it did the same kind of thing.

What Is Bass X Machina About?

“In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner,” Netflix begins to tease about what to expect from Bass X Machina , “—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he’s fighting to save.” The trailer further emphasizes that not only is it going to have steampunk elements, but it seems to be drawing from magic with its influences and threats as well.

Netflix has been home to a lot of cool original animated projects such as this, and Bass X Machina is just one of the new projects that the streaming service showed off recently alongside the upcoming Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 and Blue Eye Samurai Season 2. Which means there’s a lot to look forward to as they hit the streaming service soon. How do you feel about Bass X Machina so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Drops Final Trailer Ahead of Netflix Launch – Watch
content:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is only days away from its second season return with Netflix, and one final trailer is helping to show off what fans can expect to see from the new batch of characters. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners had what could be considered a very conclusive end to its story , but it turns out that it was far from the end of the series. Returning to Netflix for a second series of episodes, fans will see a new cast of characters making their way through Night City.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 will be introducing a whole new central cast of characters as they begin their own respective story, and it will be making its debut with Netflix in just a few more days. To get fans properly hyped for the new batch of episodes, Netflix has dropped a slick final trailer for the coming episodes that shows off the kinds of explosive moments we’ll see in the coming days. You can check out the final trailer and poster for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 below.

When Does Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Come Out on Netflix?

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 will be making its debut with Netflix on October 20th worldwide as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and it’s going to be telling its own original story with a new core cast of characters at the center of it all. Running for ten episodes and touted as a standalone story rather than a direct continuation of the events seen in the first series, there don’t seem to be any other direct ties to the characters from that first wave of episodes either as revealed through the promotional materials seen for the anime thus far.

Though it’s going to be telling a brand new story, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 is going to be carrying over much of the production cast seen with the first series with Kai Ikarashi (who directed the highly memorable Episode 6 from the first season) taking over as director in cooperation with CD Projekt RED and Studio Trigger. Masahiko Otsuka and Bartosz Sztybor also returned from the first series to serve as showrunners, story writers, and producers for the new episodes with Kanno Ichigo providing the new character designs. But as mentioned, the difference is in the characters.

What’s New for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 ?

The new cast of characters for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 will be Momoka Terasawa as Roman Carax, Akari Kito as Talia Yang, Koki Uchiyama as D, and Kentaro Tone as Weak Kingsley for the Japanese audio version of the new series. As for the cast of the English dub release (which will also be available at launch), the series will star Valeria Rodriguez as Roman, Kimoy Lee as Talia, Nazeeh Tarsha as D, and Clancy Brown as Weak. But their relation to one another has yet to be fully revealed by these promotional materials.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 will be expanding on its take on the wider Cyberpunk 2077 world as these characters continue their expansion of Night City, but it’s likely going to be packed with a ton of surprises that fans won’t see coming . At the very least, these trailers prove that it’s going to be filled with a ton of intriguing style as it tells its new story. How are you liking the look of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 thus far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

When Does Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Come Out on Netflix?

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 will be making its debut with Netflix on October 20th worldwide as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and it’s going to be telling its own original story with a new core cast of characters at the center of it all. Running for ten episodes and touted as a standalone story rather than a direct continuation of the events seen in the first series, there don’t seem to be any other direct ties to the characters from that first wave of episodes either as revealed through the promotional materials seen for the anime thus far.

Though it’s going to be telling a brand new story, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 is going to be carrying over much of the production cast seen with the first series with Kai Ikarashi (who directed the highly memorable Episode 6 from the first season) taking over as director in cooperation with CD Projekt RED and Studio Trigger. Masahiko Otsuka and Bartosz Sztybor also returned from the first series to serve as showrunners, story writers, and producers for the new episodes with Kanno Ichigo providing the new character designs. But as mentioned, the difference is in the characters.
What’s New for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 ?

The new cast of characters for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 will be Momoka Terasawa as Roman Carax, Akari Kito as Talia Yang, Koki Uchiyama as D, and Kentaro Tone as Weak Kingsley for the Japanese audio version of the new series. As for the cast of the English dub release (which will also be available at launch), the series will star Valeria Rodriguez as Roman, Kimoy Lee as Talia, Nazeeh Tarsha as D, and Clancy Brown as Weak. But their relation to one another has yet to be fully revealed by these promotional materials.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 will be expanding on its take on the wider Cyberpunk 2077 world as these characters continue their expansion of Night City, but it’s likely going to be packed with a ton of surprises that fans won’t see coming . At the very least, these trailers prove that it’s going to be filled with a ton of intriguing style as it tells its new story. How are you liking the look of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 thus far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Ei Ohitsuji's Ochibure Zeus to Dorei no Ko Manga Changes Publisher
content:
The November issue of Asahi Shimbun Publications ' Nemuki+ magazine announced on Tuesday that Ei Ohitsuji 's Ochibure Zeus to Dorei no Ko ( Fallen Zeus and the Slave Boy ) manga will move to Ichijinsha 's Zero-Sum Online manga website in spring next year. Additionally, sales of the manga's digital version will halt on October 31, but purchased volumes will remain available even after distribution ends.

Ohitsuji also made the announcement on their X/Twitter account and added that the series will resume on Zero-Sum Online starting from the first chapter, with added revisions and corrections. Ohitsuji noted that the first two chapters of the manga will differ significantly from the current versions after revisions. Ohitsuji also assured readers that despite the changes, additions, and revisions, the manga's latest fifth compiled book volume will seamlessly connect with the upcoming sixth volume that Ichijinsha will publish.

Ohitsuji launched the manga in Nemuki+ in February 2022. Asahi Shimbun Publications published the manga's first volume in 2023, and the fifth volume in March 2025. The first part of the manga's story ended with the "Egypt Arc" in December 2025. With the end of the manga's first part, Ohitsuji also announced the manga's hiatus. Ohitsuji stated then that the hiatus is to review and adjust production setup for the manga, and also to recover their health.

Ohitsuji's Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court manga , the adaptation of Satsuki Nakamura 's light novel series of the same title, launched in Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Zero-Sum magazine, simultaneously with the novels in December 2020. Ichijinsha published the manga's 11th volume on September 30. Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga and released its ninth volume on August 4.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 New Poster Visual and Trailer Introduce More Characters
content:
CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 has revealed a new poster key visual and trailer ahead of the show’s October 20, 2026 release. Studio TRIGGER is back to animate, with Netflix set to exclusively stream the series. We recently spoke with the show’s writer and producer Bartosz Sztybor , who told us why they chose the studio and shared insights into the production.

The new anime is a new 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , earlier described as “a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge.” It is directed by Kai Ikarashi, who directed Episode 6 of the original anime titled “Girl on Fire.” Ichigo Kanno is the character designer, while screenplay will be handled by Masahiko Otsuka. Bartosz Sztybor is also back as showrunner, story writer, and producer. The anime was voted as the most anticipated Fall 2026 anime by Anime Corner’s followers.

You can see the new visual below.

Four of the main characters and their Japanese/English voice cast were previously revealed. They include:

• Weak Kingsley: Once known as “King,” a veteran edgerunner at the top of his game, Weak now lives in the shadow of his former glory.

• D: A Snake Nation netrunner with sharp technical skills and a sharper hunger for revenge, D hunts the killer who wiped out his clan.

• Roman Carax: A young cinephile searching for real stories. In a city that abandoned cinema for neurodance. Obsessed with documenting the truth, he closely follows the lives of other people.

• Talia Yang: Raised in the corpo towers, but hardened by the trials of Maelström, Talia is fiercely independent, steeped in hyperviolent culture, and obsessed with her gang’s chrome.

Also watch the new trailer:

CD PROJEKT RED (or CDPR) is the company behind the Cyberpunk 2077 video game. Studio TRIGGER also animated the first CYBERPUNK: EDGE RUNNERS anime series, which was released in September 2022 and also had a total of 10 episodes. The franchise launched a prequel manga focused on Rebecca and Pilar in December 2024.

The first anime was voted as the Best New Anime of the year in our yearly awards for that year, as well as the Best Original Anime. Netflix is streaming the show , describing its story: The series tells a standalone, 10-episode story about a street kid trying to survive in Night City — a technology and body modification-obsessed city of the future. Having everything to lose, he stays alive by becoming an edgerunner — a mercenary outlaw also known as a cyberpunk.
